nodes.label: Deterministic Risk Layer (Claude cannot override)
nodes.rationale: Claude proposes trades but a risk layer enforced in code caps size; the LLM cannot exceed hard limits (max position, daily-loss halt, equity floor, no-leverage). For real money this deterministic core is a safety superiority over LLM-debated risk.

nodes.label: Kill Switch (blocks new buys, closing never blocked)
nodes.norm_label: kill switch (blocks new buys, closing never blocked)

nodes.label: Paper/Live Interlock
nodes.rationale: Going live requires TRADING_MODE=live AND api.alpaca.markets AND KILL_SWITCH=off together; the bot refuses to start if these disagree, so it can't be flipped to live by accident.

nodes.label: Account-change Auto-reset
nodes.rationale: Dashboard and safety memory belong to one account; on startup the bot notices the account changed (recreated / paper->live) and resets itself, archiving old data under state/archive/.

nodes.label: Decision Cycle (15m slow brain)
nodes.rationale: Runs every DECISION_INTERVAL_SECONDS (default 900s), only when market open; discovers, judges, sizes and places. The slow thesis brain, gated by kill switch for new buys.

nodes.label: Watchdog Loop (30s fast safety net)
nodes.rationale: Runs every MONITOR_INTERVAL_SECONDS (default 30s) on a daemon thread; closing is NEVER gated. Can sell at any time even while the decision thread is blocked on the LLM.

nodes.label: Held-position Keep-vs-Sell on Two Clocks
nodes.rationale: A held name is re-judged every 30s by price (deterministic stops) and every 15m by thesis (Claude can return sell); both routes pass through RiskManager.

nodes.label: Stale-thesis / Time-stop Exit Gap
nodes.rationale: Originally a name that quietly stops working but never hits a price stop and is never flagged by Claude would be held indefinitely; the deterministic time-stop / thesis-decay exit closes that gap.

nodes.label: Capital-Preservation Stack
nodes.rationale: No strategy can guarantee you never drop below principal (gaps/halts jump stops); the goal is SMALL, BOUNDED, SURVIVABLE losses via layered %-based caps, vol-targeted fractional-Kelly sizing, brackets, and the watchdog.

nodes.label: Margin-only Account Decision
nodes.rationale: Alpaca is margin-only (no cash account), so the small live float is a margin account with ~2x buying power. Consequences: PDT guard is essential, and the no-leverage gross cap pins deployment to <=100% of equity so borrowed money is never used.

nodes.label: Fractional-position Protection
nodes.rationale: Live default is fractional (small margin float) and fractional buys carry no exchange bracket, so the bot refuses any buy with no stop and the watchdog registers a stop on every fractional fill; the overnight/halt gap residual is irreducible.

nodes.label: Multi-user / Multi-tenant North Star
nodes.rationale: Signals/scanner are global (compute once); decision-sizing, risk, execution, monitoring are per-account. Current architecture (pure signals, file-path-parameterized state/ledger) is already well-suited.

nodes.label: Regulatory/Legal Gate (resolve before multi-user build)
nodes.rationale: Trading others' money may require IA/broker-dealer registration. Each person running their OWN instance with their OWN keys is a different posture than managing funds; settle the legal model before building 5.1-5.5.

nodes.label: Options / IPO Small-account Constraints
nodes.rationale: Options need ~$2-3k to be usable and IPOs aren't available via Alpaca's API; small accounts are equity/ETF/fractional only.

nodes.label: Backtest Harness (edge-proving)
nodes.rationale: Replays EntrySignals through the REAL RiskManager sizing gate and the same deterministic exit lifecycle the live watchdog runs, so tuning KELLY/vol/stops here maps 1:1 to production. Not replayed: the signal->Claude step.

nodes.label: Data-subscription Decision Gate
nodes.rationale: Turns 'don't pay for data before you can measure it helps' into a mechanical gate: joins ledger signal-attribution P&L to candidate subscriptions and returns SUBSCRIBE / KEEP MEASURING / INSUFFICIENT DATA.

nodes.label: Signal Attribution / Reflection Loop
nodes.rationale: Adopted cheaply from TradingAgents' reflection/memory loop: reconstructs closed round-trips from the ledger, scores each entry-signal source by realized win-rate + avg P&L, and injects a terse Track-record block into the decision prompt.

nodes.label: TradingAgents Review (what to adopt/reject)
nodes.rationale: Adopted: technical analyst signals, internal bull/bear reasoning in one prompt, reflection/attribution loop. Rejected: LangGraph multi-call orchestration, LLM-debated risk (would weaken the deterministic safety core), per-ticker multi-agent fan-out (token cost).

nodes.label: Quiver Paid-tier Shared Client + Datasets
nodes.rationale: One per-cycle shared Quiver client (Bearer auth, 429 backoff, path-keyed cache). HAVE: congress/senate/house trading, offexchange, govcontracts, lobbying, flights. NEED UPGRADE (403): wallstreetbets, insiders (free via Finnhub+EDGAR anyway), 13F, twitter.

nodes.label: Account P&L Tracker (Alpaca truth)
nodes.rationale: The ledger structurally undercounts because exchange-side bracket auto-fills never pass through our code, so the honest are-we-up view is sourced from the Alpaca account: total_return = equity - base_value - net_cashflows.

nodes.label: Watchdog CRITICAL Alerting
nodes.rationale: Pages a human on every watchdog CRITICAL (naked position after a failed close) and the latched equity-floor halt via Gmail SMTP + optional webhook. Fails open (never raises into the safety loop) and is throttled per event key.

nodes.label: Earnings-blackout Guard
nodes.rationale: Rejects new buys within N days of a report (gap risk dwarfs the stop); sells/exits are never blacked out. Fails open on unknown earnings dates.
